audit_method: Independent true-class/clean-prediction/perturbed-prediction contingency tables; no import of diagnostic metric implementation.
limitations: Recomputed uploaded predictions, not fresh GPU inference from full model weights.
Checkpoint metadata matches the previous evidence archive; full checkpoint files remain on DISLAB.
Client class counts and split hashes are reported metadata; raw split indices are not in these exports.
No benign-trained model or post-FU evaluation in these exports.
One training seed; the 1000-image sample is contained in the full test set, not an independent training repeat.

subset_comparison.note: Train-mode BN uses different batches. Permuted-noise RNG assigns permutations by sample position, so the two sample orders do not produce the same noise for the same image.
